content.body: The M3A1 Grease Gun is an iconic submachine gun used by the Allied forces. It was cheap to make and effective. Though it had a slower rate of fire than most smg's it was very reliable and the barrel could be changed out to use 9mm rounds.
content.brief: WEAPON: M3A1 Grease Gun SMG AMMO: .45 cal Auto Colt Pistol (ACP) MAGAZINE: 30 rounds MUZZLE VELOCITY: 280 m/s RATE OF FIRE: 450 rpm OTHER EQUIPMENT: Pistolet Automatique mle 1935A 7.65 mm Grenade OF (HE) (4) Grenade Fumigène (Smoke Grenades) (2) Combat Knife
content.title: Submachine Gunner (Fusilier Voltigeur PM)
